Name: Mental Fortification
Description: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws. If a creature attempts to read the thoughts of this spell’s target while they are under this effect, the target become aware of it, and can choose to end the spell to automatically shut the creature out of their mind for 24 hours.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
